rationale: The agent did run authentication and lookup tools (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details, get_order_details) and appears to act on the user’s orders. However, it executed order-changing write actions (exchange_delivered_order_items for both the hiking boots and the jigsaw) without any explicit user confirmation beforehand, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The final message provided no concrete exchange details (e.g., confirmation numbers, return labels, shipping info). It is also not demonstrated that the replacement jigsaw met the user’s constraints beyond calling get_product_details. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
